title: How it works
text:
How the form emails work
Overview of all emails

What this document is
Tabs: each tab after this one is one email. The "Sent:" line at the top of each tab is the rule the code follows.
Placeholders: the words in curly brackets are filled in for each person: {NAME}, {ID}, {LINK}, {NOMINATE_LINK}, {NOMINATOR}, {ACCEPT_LINK}, {UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK}, {SENT_DATE}, {STARTED_DATE}. An email is not sent if its text has another word in curly brackets.
How sending works
Data: form answers are saved in the V4AIR forms Google Sheet, in the tabs Applications, Nominations, Nominees and Speakers. Tab Unsubscribed lists addresses that get no more emails.
Script: an Apps Script attached to the Sheet sends the emails. It runs on Google's servers, so it does not depend on anyone's computer being on.
Timer: the script runs every 5 minutes. Each run reads the Sheet, sends the emails that are due and writes the send time into the Sheet. Confirmations therefore arrive within about 5 minutes of a form being sent.
Email log: every sent email is listed in the Sheet tab "Email log" with the date, the address and the email name.
Replies: replies go to the sender address and are forwarded to Peter and Petr.
Rules for all emails
Check at send time: a reminder is sent only if the person still has not done what it asks for.
Once only: each email goes to each person at most once.
One a day: each person gets at most one email per day. If two are due on the same day, the more important one goes first: confirmations, then deadline reminders, then nominee emails, then nominate reminders. The other moves to the next day.
Unsubscribe: every email ends with an Unsubscribe link (live since 8 November 2026: v4air.eu/unsubscribe/, one personal token per address). Opening it writes the address into the Sheet tab "Unsubscribed", and they get nothing more. If someone instead replies that they do not want emails, their address is added to that tab by hand. Confirmations are the exception: a form that is sent still gets its confirmation.
Two roles: if a nominated person applies, their nominee emails stop. People are matched by email address.
Same address: reminders about an unfinished form stop if the same email address has already sent the same form, for example after starting a second application instead of finishing the first.
Counting from the last save: resume reminders count from the last save, so a person who saves again after a reminder starts a new count.
Deadline: after 15 January 2027 only confirmations are sent, and later the results emails.
Flow 1: Applications
Application confirmation: right after the application is sent. Once.
Application resume: one day after the last save, if the application is unfinished. Once.
Application resume 2: 7 days after the last save, if the application is still unfinished. Skipped if a deadline reminder is due within 3 days.
Deadline reminder: 1 week: 8 January 2027, to everyone with an unfinished application.
Deadline reminder: last day: 14 January 2027, to everyone whose application is still unfinished.
Stops when: the application is sent, the person says no, or 15 January 2027 passes (except the confirmation).
Flow 2: Asking applicants to nominate others
Application confirmation: includes a short request to nominate others, with the nominate link.
Nominate reminder 1: 3 days after the application is sent, if the applicant has not nominated anyone.
Nominate reminder 2: 14 days after the application is sent, if there is still no nomination.
Nominate reminder 3: 28 days after the application is sent, if there is still no nomination. Last email of this flow.
Stops when: the applicant nominates someone, says no, or 15 January 2027 passes.
Flow 3: Nominations
Nomination confirmation: to the person who nominated, right after the nomination form is sent. Once.
Nominee invitation: to each nominated person with an email address, right after the nomination. It always names the nominator.
Nominee reminder: 7 days after the invitation, with the accept link again. The only reminder and the last email to the nominee.
Accept link: both nominee emails link to v4air.eu/accept-nomination/, where the person accepts (and continues to the application form) or declines. Declining, replying "no" or unsubscribing deletes their details straight away.
Stops when: the nominee applies, declines, replies "no", unsubscribes, or 15 January 2027 passes.
Data: if the nominee does not apply, the mailer deletes their details 30 days after the nomination (a daily check).
Flow 4: Speakers
Speaker confirmation: right after the speaker form is sent. Once.
Speaker resume: one day after the last save, if the form is unfinished. Once.
Speaker resume 2: 4 days after the last save, if the form is still unfinished.
Speaker resume 3: 10 days after the last save, if the form is still unfinished. Last automatic reminder.
Stops when: the form is sent, or the person says no.
Sending limits
Gmail through Apps Script: 100 recipients per day on a personal Google account. Emails over the limit go out the next day.
Resend free plan (if used): 100 emails per day and 3,000 per month.
Status on 18 November 2026
In the code (backend/Code.gs, sendMail, site PRs #38 and the nominee follow-up): every email in this Doc is built. The mailer reads the texts from this Doc on every run (nothing is copied into the code), keeps a tab "Email log", sends at most one email per person per day in the order of the table above, retries failed emails, and deletes nominee details after 30 days. Rows saved before go-live count as saved at go-live; a confirmation or resume more than 3 days late uses the "(late)" tab. The mailer is in dry run: the Sheet tab "Mail preview" shows what would go out. Nothing is sent until Petr switches it on.
Not automatic: a "no" sent by email. Someone reading info@v4air.eu adds the address to tab Unsubscribed; the daily check then deletes a nominee's details.
Sender: info@v4air.eu through Resend (DKIM for v4air.eu, records added 18 November 2026), replies to info@v4air.eu. DMARC p=none since 8 November 2026.

title: Application confirmation
text:
Sent: After someone submits the application form. Sent once.
Keep the words in curly brackets. They are filled in for each person.

Subject: We received your V4AIR application {ID}

Hello {NAME},

Thank you. We received your application for the V4 AI Researchers Meetup (V4AIR).

Your application ID: {ID}
Keep it. It is in every email we send you about the meetup.

You can change your answers until 15 January 2027 through this link:

{LINK}

This link is personal. Anyone who has it can open your answers, so please do not forward this email.

Selection results come in February 2027.

Do you know someone who should be at V4AIR too? You can nominate students, researchers and people who work with AI outside academia here:
{NOMINATE_LINK}

If you have a question, reply to this email.

V4 AI Researchers Meetup (V4AIR)
Kostelec Castle, 28 to 30 April 2027
https://v4air.eu
Unsubscribe: {UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK}

title: Nominee invitation
text:
Sent: When a nomination is submitted, to each nominated person with an email address. It always names the nominator. Not sent if the person declined, unsubscribed or already applied, and not after 15 January 2027.
Keep the words in curly brackets. They are filled in for each person.

Subject: You were nominated for V4AIR

Hello {NAME},

{NOMINATOR} nominated you for the V4 AI Researchers Meetup (V4AIR).

V4AIR is a three-day meetup at Kostelec Castle near Prague, 28 to 30 April 2027, for master's and PhD students and early-career researchers who use AI methods in their research, or have data that AI could help with.

We got your name and email address from {NOMINATOR}, through the nomination form on our website.

Please accept or decline the nomination here:
{ACCEPT_LINK}

Accept: you continue to the application form. It is one online form, with no CV and no motivation letter. Applications close on 15 January 2027.
Decline: we delete your details straight away and do not contact you again.
Do nothing: we send you one reminder in a week, and we delete your details 30 days after the nomination.

You can also simply reply "no" to this email, and we will delete your details.

How we handle your details: https://v4air.eu/policy/privacy/#nominations

If you have a question, reply to this email.

V4 AI Researchers Meetup (V4AIR)
Kostelec Castle, 28 to 30 April 2027
https://v4air.eu
Unsubscribe: {UNSUBSCRIBE_LINK}
